bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tumblrkit.telegram_bridge_client import LocalTelegramOwner
def sql(q):
 return subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",q],text=True,timeout=12).strip()
topic=sql("SELECT topic_id FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 1")
assert topic.isdecimal(), "NO_VERIFIED_TOPIC"
members=sql("SELECT tg_user_id FROM gate_sessions WHERE step='approved' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 12").splitlines()
if not members: print("NO_APPROVED_USERS_AVAILABLE");sys.exit(28)
owner=LocalTelegramOwner(Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token")
for uid in members:
 if not uid.isdecimal():continue
 try:
  r=owner.perform("telegram.check_membership",topic+":"+uid,{})
 except Exception:
  continue
 if r.get("verified") is True:
  print("REAL_APPROVED_JOINED_USER_VERIFIED=PASS")
  sys.exit(0)
print("NO_JOINED_APPROVED_USER_IN_SELECTED_GROUP")
sys.exit(29)
PY
